title: Roti Khurasan (Beef-Stuffed Crispy Spring Roll Burger)
description: A unique snack that wraps a spiced minced-beef burger bun in spring roll pastry and deep-fries until crispy — crunchy outside, hearty inside.
description_ms: Makanan unik yang membalut burger bun berinti daging cincang berbumbu dengan kulit popia kemudian digoreng sehingga crispy — garing kat luar, padat kat dalam.
steps: Sauté 1 sweet onion and 5 garlic cloves (chopped); add 200 g frozen minced beef.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 2 tbsp chilli sauce; add water to prevent burning.
Season with black pepper, salt and seasoning powder; cook until the filling is dry. Set aside.
Cut a burger bun in half; spread butter on both sides.
Spread a little mayonnaise on the cut surfaces; add the beef filling generously, a little more chilli sauce and a slice of cheese.
Press the bun halves together and wrap tightly in spring roll pastry, sealing all edges with water.
Deep-fry in very hot oil for just a few seconds until golden and puffed. Drain and serve hot.
steps_ms: Tumis 1 biji bawang Holland dan 5 ulas bawang putih (dihacam); masukkan 200g daging cincang beku.
Masukkan 2 sudu serbuk kari, 1 sudu sos tomato, 1 sudu sos tiram dan 2 sudu sos cili; masukkan air elak hangus.
Tambah black pepper, garam dan serbuk perasa; masak sehingga inti kering. Ketepikan.
Potong roti burger menjadi dua; sapu butter di kedua-dua belah.
Sapu sedikit mayo pada permukaan yang dipotong; letak inti daging banyak-banyak, sedikit sos cili lagi dan sekeping cheese.
Kepit dua bahagian bun dan balut rapat dengan kulit popia, lekatkan semua tepi dengan air.
Goreng dalam minyak betul-betul panas hanya beberapa saat sehingga golden dan kembang. Toskan dan hidang panas.
